title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows and bump GH Actions/deps for hygiene
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions workflows had grown organically and many jobs used older action versions, duplicated matrices, and inconsistent caching. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows across the monorepo, upgrades GH Actions and runner images, normalizes cache keys, reduces duplication between SDK and core pipelines, and bumps small dev dependencies for security/hygiene. The goals are: 1) reduce CI runtime variance, 2) improve cache hit rates, 3) simplify maintenance surface, and 4) unblock future parallelism improvements. Changes: - Split monolithic workflow into three focused workflows: lint.yml, test.yml, and release.yml (release remains gated to protected branches). - Unify node-version matrix (node 20 LTS only for most jobs, node 18 preserved for legacy build job). - Upgrade commonly used actions to pinned v3/v4 versions, replace deprecated actions, and add minimal inputs for hermetic runs. - Standardize cache keys (repo-specific + hash of lockfile + OS + node). - Normalize Docker build/test steps for redwood-private-installer and perf-canary to reuse a common workflow template. - Bump devDeps in root package.json: actions/cache, actions/setup-node, eslint plugins, and a couple of test helpers. - Remove duplicated token-scoped secrets where possible and ensure release workflow uses least-privilege PAT with clear scopes. Testing: Ran workflows against this branch; initial run had a lint flake (eslint rule change) which was fixed in second commit. Ran integration test matrix on a subset of repositories (redwood, redwood-sdk-python, redwood-helm-charts). Observability: Added a small section in the release workflow that emits a build-metadata artifact and a summary comment on PRs with run durations to help track regressions. Rollout: Merged to main and monitored CI for 48 hours; reverted one cache key change that lowered hit rates on forks. Related: Linear ENG-8421, ENG-9002. Checklist: - [x] Upgrade pinned GH Action versions - [x] Consolidate workflows into lint/test/release - [x] Normalize caching strategy - [x] Bump devDeps and lockfiles - [x] Add CI artifacts and PR summary comment - [x] Smoke-run tests across core repos
commits: 3 commits: 1) consolidate-workflows: split monorepo workflows, add templates and shared job definitions (S. Patel), 2) deps: bump GH Actions and devDeps, update lockfiles, 3) fix(eslint): adjust rule exceptions after lint job run revealed new failures
review_comments: Miguel Torres (review): Nice consolidation — can we pin actions using full SHAs for the most security-sensitive steps?

Sofia Patel (reply): I pinned the critical actions (setup-node, checkout) to SHAs where available and left semver pins for well-maintained actions; added a note in the workflow about which are SHA-pinned.
Anika Rao (request_changes): The cache key change broke forks — can we include repo name in key to avoid collisions?
Sofia Patel (commit): Updated cache key to include github.repository and validated hit rate on a forked run; added fallback logic and documented trade-offs.
Ethan Zhang (approve): LGTG — observed ~25% faster lint/test median runtime on main runs.
release_notes: CI/CD: Consolidate and modernize GitHub Actions workflows; upgrade GH Actions and devDeps; standardize cache keys; add PR CI artifacts for runtime tracking. No functional changes to production code. Improves CI reliability and maintainability.
